description: Data centers en Seine-Saint-Denis is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de la Seine-Saint-Denis. Localisation des sites d’hébergement de serveurs informatiques. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Vie économique - innovation. Its keywords are Numérique, IDG, geoidf. The portal shows 10 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support digital infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
